benchmark.name: CoreMark 1.0 (wasm-coremark-rs minimal MVP module)
benchmark.host_contract: import env.clock_ms: () -> i32; export run: () -> f32 (score, higher is better)

host.note: Shared cloud host, not the Apple M4 Stage B host. Scores are comparable only within this run.

profile.tool: valgrind callgrind 3.22.0 on a production build with STRIP=false DEBUG=line-tables-only
observations: Every memory access lowers to LoadCapture(memory) + WasmMemoryAddress + WasmMemoryLoad/Store; WasmMemoryAddress boxes the effective address as a heap Cell::WasmBits64.
Every 64-bit scalar result allocates Cell::WasmBits64, which drives the GC share.
Each memory access locks the MemoryStorage mutex, including unshared memories.
Wasm-to-Wasm calls recurse through call_user / call_user_maybe_async because inline frame push is disabled for ProgramKind::Wasm.
Numeric operators dispatch twice: the opcode (WasmI32Binary) and then an operator tag decoded from the immediate.
local.get/local.set lower to LoadLocal/StoreLocal copies into operand-stack registers.
